title: Logos 23 opening: all given into the Son’s hand
english: Twenty-third discourse. On “the Father loves the Son and has given all into his hand,” and kindred receiving texts.
Receiving language is kept with shared possession: all the Father has is the Son’s.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Condensed lemma-led tip.
No Greystone wording. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
